answer_1.quote: However, these benchmarks use reference-based evaluation metrics like BLEU, which have been shown to have low validity... for automated generation of natural language (NL) review comments.

answer_2.quote: We propose CRScore, an automated but reference-free evaluation metric...

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-a-judge (LaaJ): Following recent developments (Zheng et al., 2023) we develop an LLM prompting-based approach that compares the model-generated reviews against CodeReviewer references to generate relevance scores.
methods: prompting-based approach with descriptions of Con, Comp, and Rel dimensions

answer_4.quote: To show that CRScore aligns with the human judgment of review quality along the proposed dimensions: comprehensiveness, conciseness, and relevance we gather annotations from the same annotators on reviews generated by 9 systems...
answer_4.guideline: The raters again follow a codebook that contains guidelines and examples for annotating each dimension using the pseudo-references on a 5-point Likert scale.
